question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

My parents used to __encouraged me to devote__ more time to study.
solution:
The **correct answer** is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct answer is: 'Encourage me to devote
